name: DrillPathBar
description:
Where a drill-down is: the root, each ancestor (each one navigates back) and the current
node. One line at the head's height; the middle collapses to "…" when the path is long and
every crumb truncates with an ellipsis.
signature: ({ trail, onSelect, label }: { trail: readonly Node[]; onSelect: (depth: number) => void; label?: string; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: label
props.description: The visible or accessible label for this component.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Event callback; the typed signature specifies its arguments.

props.name: trail
props.description: Ancestor trail before the current item.
